EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches at 2881/2939 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and a CH2/CH3 deformation near 1454 cm⁻¹, consistent with a saturated hydrocarbon framework. The paired bands at 829 and 754 cm⁻¹ strongly suggest ring modes of a saturated cyclic ether; open-chain alcohols/amine candidates typically show a CH2 rocking around ~720 cm⁻¹ instead. The 1032 cm⁻¹ band fits a ring C–C/C–O stretching region expected for ethers. The weak feature at 2744 cm⁻¹ can be a combination/Fermi-type band (SPC-002). Absence of a 2200–2300 cm⁻¹ band excludes the diisocyanate (10). Among cyclic ether candidates, CC1CCCCOC1C (5) best matches the 750–830 cm⁻¹ ring pattern and overall saturated-ether profile.
